symptomShortText: Shaft outer diameter below lower tolerance after turning

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-2914, Shift B - ran the released program as written
EQ-TURN02-004, spindle runout 4um, within the 10um limit
DOC-5120 Rev A - turning work instruction still carries the pre-2025 tool offset and was never revised after the fixture change in 2026-04
Bar stock cert PASS, hardness 212 HB within band

fiveWhyChain.question: Why is the shaft outer diameter below the lower tolerance?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Measured 24.912mm against a 24.950mm lower limit - the tool cut 0.041mm deeper than nominal

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the tool cut deeper than nominal?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The turning program applied the old tool offset, which no longer matches the fixture datum after the 2026-04 change

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the old offset still in use?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Work instruction DOC-5120 Rev A was never revised when the fixture changed, so the released program remained the pre-2025 version

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the fixture change not trigger a work instruction revision? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The engineering change process has no mandatory link from a fixture change to the affected work instructions, so the revision was never raised

actions.actionText: Quarantine batch B-51044 and 100% gauge the outer diameter of all S150 shafts in WIP and finished stock
Correct the tool offset in the WC-TURN-02 turning program and re-release DOC-5120 as Rev B
Rework 212 affected shafts to drawing or scrap where the diameter is unrecoverable
Extend the engineering change checklist so any fixture change forces a review of every linked work instruction before release

fmeaLink.description: Tool offset mismatch after fixture change

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Tying the defect start date to the fixture change date narrowed the search to one document in a single day
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The change process treated fixtures and work instructions as unrelated, so a known change silently invalidated a released program

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: S150 outer diameter - WC-TURN-02 - all parts turned after the 2026-04 fixture change
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: S120 / S180 variants - WC-TURN-01 and WC-TURN-04 - fixtures unchanged, offsets still valid
isIsNot.notes: Defect starts exactly at the fixture change date, not at a tool or batch change
